Gold, the second biggest import item for India in terms of value, is increasingly playing an important role in the circular economy that can meet part of the demand for the yellow metal from internal sources and save precious foreign exchange reserves. To integrate gold into the circular economy, every stakeholder is stepping up to bring in more transparency, trust, purity and responsible mining practices, experts from the field said.The panel consisted of Asher O, MD – India Operations, Malabar Gold & Diamonds; Sachin Jain, Regional CEO India, World Gold Council; Vikram Dhawan, Head Commodities and Fund Manager, Nippon India Mutual Fund, Kaushlendra Sinha, CEO, Indian Association for Gold Excellence and Standards; and Mayank Sharma, President and Head of Gold Loan, IIFL Finance.Asher said Malabar Gold & Diamonds meets about 80% of the demand for gold from people trading in their old stock. Sinha of IAGES said a recent study by the entity showed a large number of young buyers were asking about gold’s source, indicating a responsible buying attitude. Jain of WGC said they released a report suggesting responsible mining in India to substitute excessive dependence on imports. Sharma discussed gold loans and how credit flow from the sector is helping households and MSMEs. Dhawan explained how gold ETFs are leading to financialisation of the metal.tnn

Article Title: "Dam did him bad": Salahdine Parnasse stunned Dan Hooker in his UFC Paris debut as fighters react to a performance that changed everything
Article Text:
Salahdine Parnasse (Image via IG/X)

Salahdine Parnasse turned one opening against Dan Hooker into a brutal first-round finish

Salahdine Parnasse now has the attention of the lightweight division after his UFC arrival

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Salahdine Parnasse could hardly have asked for a better UFC debut. Fighting Dan Hooker in the main event of UFC Paris, the French star needed only one round to make his presence known. His finish impressed fighters watching from outside the Octagon, while Parnasse quickly showed that he has much bigger ambitions for his UFC run. What happened in Paris was more than a debut win. It was an arrival that immediately changed the conversation around him.Parnasse entered the UFC with plenty of attention already around him. The promotion had trusted him with a main-event spot in Paris, giving him a major opportunity in front of his home crowd.There was little time for him to settle in.The opening exchanges were measured, with both fighters using kicks and looking for openings. Parnasse did not appear interested in forcing the finish. Instead, he stayed composed and waited for Hooker to give him an opportunity.That moment arrived with a damaging body kick.Parnasse landed cleanly to Hooker's midsection, and the New Zealander immediately showed that the shot had affected him.Parnasse recognized the opening and moved forward. A head kick followed before the Frenchman unleashed a fast series of punches.Hooker could not find a way out.The referee stepped in at 2:35 of the first round, giving Parnasse a knockout victory in his UFC debut.The result was especially impressive because Parnasse managed to finish an experienced opponent without allowing the fight to become a long, difficult battle. He showed patience before suddenly switching gears when the opening appeared.That detail stood out to former UFC fighter Alan Jouban.Jouban reacted to the performance on social media, writing: “Wow. impressive performance. Patient, methodical and when he decided to go was able to finish it. #UFCParis”Jouban's reaction captured what made the finish stand out. Parnasse did not spend the entire fight chasing a knockout. He waited, found the right moment and then attacked with speed.Terrance McKinney also had a strong reaction to what he saw from the French newcomer. “Damn did him bad Parnasse welcome to rankings and the ufc 👏👏👏”McKinney's comment reflected the bigger conversation developing around Parnasse. A debut victory is one thing, but a first-round knockout over a respected UFC veteran can immediately change expectations.Belal Muhammad was already looking toward the next matchup. “Aight he’s getting Michael Chandler next”The comment added Michael Chandler to the growing list of possible opponents for Parnasse and showed just how quickly the conversation moved beyond his debut.The reactions painted a clear picture of the impact Parnasse's performance had. Jouban focused on his patience and timing. McKinney saw a fighter who had already done enough to enter the rankings conversation. Muhammad was already thinking about who could be next.For a newcomer, that is a significant shift.Parnasse was not finished making his intentions known once the fight ended.During his post-fight interview, the Frenchman made it clear that he wants to move quickly through the lightweight division. He said he was ready for a top-five opponent before naming Max Holloway as the matchup he wants most.Parnasse spoke about Holloway with clear respect, calling him a legend while insisting that he is ready to share the Octagon with him.The callout gives the UFC an interesting decision.Holloway has years of experience at the highest level and has faced some of the biggest names in the sport. A fight with Parnasse would therefore be a major step up for the Frenchman after only one UFC appearance.At the same time, Parnasse's performance gave him a strong argument for being tested against a recognizable opponent.Michael Chandler is another possibility after Muhammad's reaction. Chandler would present a different challenge, particularly because of his explosive wrestling, power and experience in high-level lightweight fights.The UFC may ultimately decide that Parnasse needs another fight before entering the top-five picture. One victory is still only one victory, even when it comes against an experienced fighter like Hooker.But Parnasse has already made one thing difficult to ignore.He does not look like a fighter who intends to spend years quietly climbing the UFC ladder.His journey to the promotion was already unusual. Parnasse had previously turned down opportunities to join the UFC before eventually making the move. When the opportunity finally came, he was placed directly into a major main-event spotlight in Paris.He responded with a finish that lasted less than three minutes.Now, the attention has shifted to what comes next.The reactions from Jouban, McKinney and Muhammad showed that Parnasse's debut was not viewed as just another UFC victory. His performance gave other fighters a reason to start discussing him immediately.That is perhaps the biggest change coming out of UFC Paris.Parnasse arrived with questions surrounding how quickly he could adjust to the UFC level. He left with those questions replaced by a different one: how far can he go from here?His first UFC fight could have simply been an introduction.Instead, it became a statement that has put Parnasse firmly on the lightweight division's radar.
Article Summary: Salahdine parnasse made his ufc debut against dan hooker in the main event of ufc paris. The frenchman turned one opening into a brutal first-round finish. Former ufc fighters alan jouban and terrance mckinney reacted to the performance. Belal muhammad added michael chandler to the growing list of possible opponents.

Article Title: “That is the only thing that I have fallen short of”: Michael Page gets honest after his UFC Paris win revealing what he feels has been missing all along
Article Text:
Michael Page (Image via IG/X)

Michael Page feels he has fallen short of the “wow factor” that made him famous

Michael “Venom” Page’s UFC Paris win showed he can still adjust when the fight does not go his way

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Michael “Venom” Page walked away from UFC Paris with another win, yet the result carried more meaning than a number on his record. The British striker defeated Nursulton Ruziboev by unanimous decision after a difficult start. It was a solid performance from the veteran, though it did not bring the spectacular finish that has long been associated with his name. That makes Page’s earlier admission about his UFC career even more revealing.Page did not arrive in the UFC without a reputation.Long before making his promotional debut in 2024, he had already become one of the most recognizable fighters outside the organization. His Bellator career was built around an unusual striking style, quick movement and the ability to produce finishes that could leave fans stunned.The results have been respectable too. Page had lost only once in his first five UFC fights before facing Ruziboev. His defeat came against Ian Machado Garry in a razor-thin decision, while wins over Sharabutdin Magomedov and Jared Cannonier added some major names to his record.Still, Page has not been completely satisfied with the way his UFC story has developed.When asked if he was disappointed, the 39-year-old gave an unusually honest answer.“Yeah, it's definitely disappointing. It is a lot more difficult when you do not understand how you have gotten to this place because you do not know what you can change.”For Page, the frustration is not simply about his losses. He believes his performances have not always carried the same impact as the fights that made him famous before entering the UFC.That is where his most telling admission came.“I feel like that is the only thing that I have fallen short of. Although most of my fights have been entertaining, I feel like I have fallen short of that wow factor that I was known for.”It is a striking admission from a fighter whose reputation was built around making people wonder what he might do next.Page knows the UFC is filled with elite competition. He also understands that spectacular finishes are not guaranteed.“Obviously, we are in a game where guys are super talented. We are at the highest division, so it is never going to be a home run all the time.”That reality has not stopped him from wanting more.He still wants to create the kind of moments that made him such a popular fighter in the first place.Ruziboev gave Page a very different test in Paris.The British fighter did not have everything go his way from the opening bell. Ruziboev was able to make things difficult early, forcing Page to adjust instead of allowing him to settle into an easy striking rhythm.Page responded as an experienced fighter should.He stayed composed, found his range and grew into the contest. The fight eventually went to the judges, with Page earning a unanimous decision victory.It was another important win.It also offered an interesting contrast to what Page had said before the fight.He had already identified his lack of aggression as something he wanted to change. Looking back at his previous performances, Page believed he could have pushed the action more instead of waiting for the perfect opportunity.“Yeah, I guess potentially you can have regrets in retrospect,” he said.“With fights, you can learn from them. Everything else you cannot really control.”His solution was clear.“The main side of it would be to have a bit more output in some of my fights so that would be really trying to go for the win by being a bit more bloodthirsty.”That mindset makes the Paris performance particularly interesting.Page won the fight without needing to force a finish. He showed patience and the ability to recover from a challenging start. Those are valuable qualities, especially against an opponent who can create problems in multiple areas.Yet the fight also showed why Page continues to talk about the missing spark in his UFC career.The spectacular finish never came.Instead, he earned his victory through adjustments, striking and control over the later stages of the fight.There is nothing wrong with that approach. Fighters at this level cannot chase a knockout at every moment and risk throwing away a winnable fight.For Page, however, the standard is different because of what he has already accomplished.He knows what it feels like to produce moments that fans remember.He knows how quickly one perfect strike can change a fight.That is the version of himself he is still trying to bring back to the UFC stage.The Paris victory showed that Page remains capable of solving problems inside the cage. It also showed that the issue he openly identified before the fight has not completely disappeared.Now Page is looking for that feeling that once made his fights impossible to ignore.For the veteran, perhaps that is the real challenge ahead. Not simply winning more fights, but finding a way to make those wins feel unmistakably like Michael “Venom” Page.
Article Summary: Michael page feels he has fallen short of the "wow factor" that made him famous. The 39-year-old defeated nursulton ruziboev by unanimous decision in paris. Page had lost only once in his first five ufc fights. The paris victory showed that page remains capable of solving problems inside the cage.

Article Title: “Tom, come over, cutie": Alix Earle’s Tom Brady romance gets its biggest update yet as influencer breaks silence on Netflix reality show
Article Text:
Tom Brady and Alix Earle (Image via Getty Images)

Alix Earle breaks her silence on Tom Brady relationship

Tom Brady and Alix Earle's romance follows her difficult breakup

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Alix Earle has finally offered her first public glimpse into the romance that had kept fans guessing for months. The 25-year-old influencer addressed her rumored relationship with Tom Brady on her new Netflix reality series, Earle Meets World. Rather than making a formal announcement, Earle kept things playful and vague, giving viewers just enough to understand that the two had grown closer.The moment came during the second episode of Earle Meets World, when Earle was rehearsing with her Dancing with the Stars partner Val Chmerkovskiy.His wife, Jenna Johnson, entered the studio and quickly picked up on the subject that had been following Earle in the headlines.When Johnson asked what was going on, Earle did not exactly confirm a relationship. Instead, she gave a coy response that suggested she was enjoying the new chapter of her life.“I don’t know what’s going on,” Earle responded. “I’m having fun.”Johnson then asked if the relationship was confirmed. Earle shrugged and again avoided putting a label on it.“No, I’m just having fun,” said Earle, coyly. “I know, a lot has changed since last time.”Johnson responded warmly before bringing up Earle's previous relationship with NFL player Braxton Berrios.“Love that for you,” Johnson replied. “How are you doing after, like, Braxton?”“I’m good,” replied Earle.Johnson then joked about Brady entering the picture, saying, “Then you were like, ‘Tom, come over, cutie,’ ” while pretending to make a phone call.The exchange gave viewers their clearest look yet at Earle's side of the story, even though neither she nor Brady has publicly defined the relationship.Rumors surrounding Earle and Brady began after they were seen together around New Year's Eve in St. Barths. The pair later crossed paths again during Super Bowl weekend, when social media footage showed them talking and dancing at a party.The speculation intensified after PEOPLE reported in February that a source described the pair as “hooking up.” Representatives for both Earle and Brady have not commented on the report.The timing also drew attention because Earle had recently ended her two-year relationship with Berrios. Their breakup came after a difficult period of long-distance dating, with Berrios focused on his NFL career and Earle working on Dancing with the Stars.Earle later spoke openly about how difficult the transition was for her. In a January TikTok, she admitted that being without a partner felt unfamiliar because she had spent much of her adult life in relationships.“I think I’ve just always had boyfriends. I was, like, a boyfriend hopper,” she said at the time. “This year, I’m gonna be dedicated to being OK with being alone. But I don’t know why I can’t do it. This is like growth or something, but I’m sad.”Earle also acknowledged that loneliness did not necessarily mean she was truly alone.“I feel like it just makes life feel so lonely, but it’s not, and I’m not lonely.”Now, with Earle Meets World giving audiences a closer look at her personal life, the Tom Brady chapter has moved from speculation into something she is willing to discuss, even if she is still keeping the details to herself.
Article Summary: Alix earle has finally offered her first public glimpse into the romance that had kept fans guessing for months. The 25-year-old influencer addressed her rumored relationship with tom brady on her new netflix reality series, earle meets world. Rather than making a formal announcement, she kept things playful and vague.

Article Title: "I'll never stop being proud": Randi Mahomes gets emotional over Patrick Mahomes’ stunning 27-year full-circle moment in Times Square
Article Text:
Patrick Mahomes and Randi Mahomes (Instagram)

Randi Mahomes celebrates Patrick Mahomes' journey with a 27-year throwback

Patrick Mahomes' NFL journey gives Randi Mahomes plenty to celebrate

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Randi Mahomes had a full-circle moment in New York City when she spotted her son Patrick Mahomes on a giant Times Square screen. Nearly three decades after posing with her young son and her own mother, Randi returned to a very different picture of his life. This time, the boy beside her had become one of the NFL 's biggest stars, making the moment especially meaningful for his proud mother.The Kansas City Chiefs quarterback's rise has given his family plenty of milestones to celebrate, but Randi's latest post focused on something more personal than another football achievement.She shared two images side by side. The first showed Patrick as a child with Randi and his grandmother. The second showed Randi standing in Times Square in front of an advertisement featuring her son.The contrast between the photographs captured just how dramatically Patrick's life has changed. What began as a family photo 27 years ago eventually led to his face appearing on one of the world's most recognizable advertising landmarks.Randi summed up the emotion behind the moment in a short message:"27 years later and you ended up on one of the big screens," Randi wrote. "I'll never stop being proud of you."For Randi, Patrick's success also carries the memory of the years it took to get there. She has spoken openly about raising three children as a single mother and the demands that came with balancing work and family.Patrick entered the NFL in 2017, when the Chiefs selected him with the 10th overall pick. He quickly developed into the centerpiece of the franchise and has since won three Super Bowl titles and two NFL MVP awards.His path has not been without difficult stretches. The Chiefs missed the playoffs last season after finishing 6-11, ending a postseason run that had lasted for years. Patrick also suffered a torn ACL in December, forcing him into a long rehabilitation process.That makes Randi's Times Square post more than a celebration of fame. It is a reminder of the distance between Patrick's childhood and the career he has built.Randi has previously described the less visible side of raising her children while supporting Patrick's ambitions."People don't see the constant balancing act," Randi said. "You have to be the nurturer and the disciplinarian, the provider and the protector. You carry it all, and some days, that's heavier than anyone realizes."I missed a lot… school events, social outings, holidays. I worked long hours to make sure they had what they needed. That was the trade-off, but I'd do it again in a heartbeat."Now, with Patrick preparing for another season with Kansas City and working his way back from injury, Randi can look at that old family photograph and see how far her son has come.A child once standing beside his mother is now staring back from one of Times Square's giant screens. For Randi, 27 years made all the difference.
Article Summary: Randi mahomes shared a 27-year throwback photo of her and her son. Patrick mahomes is now one of the biggest stars in the nfl. The photo shows randi standing in times square in front of an advertisement. She wrote: "i'll never stop being proud of you"

Coco Gauff, the 22 year old World number four, has been a force to be reckoned with on the court. While Coco Gauff has achieved a lot of success and wealth through tennis, she has also turned into a successful entrepreneur. Amid the 2026 US Open, one of her investments has nearly doubled in the last few months.As per reports, Coco Gauff’s investment in Unrivaled, the professional 3-on-3 women's basketball league, has been pretty profitable as it has now hit a valuation of a whopping $650 million.A few days ago, Unrivaled announced its Series C fundraise led by Ten Pillars Sports Fund (backed by UC Investments) has crossed the initial $100 million target and is now oversubscribed at a league valuation of $650 million.For the unversed, back in January 2025, Coco Gauff’s capital in Unrivaled was part of the $35 million total early funding that the company secured ahead of its first season. This consisted of a $7 million seed round and a $28 million Series A round.The three Grand Slam champion Coco Gauff had opened up about her investment as she said, “I’m thrilled to be joining Unrivaled as an investor…Basketball is one of my favorite sports, and the chance to support a league that’s redefining the game is exciting.”The 22 year old tennis star added, “I look forward to being part of this movement and continuing to help elevate women’s sports to new heights.”Coco Gauff also joked about it on her social media as she posted,“My dad always wanted me to follow in his footsteps and play basketball…Haha sorry dad but this is as close as it will get 🤣.”While Coco Gauff is undoubtedly one of the greatest athletes that the world has seen,she has also been pretty busy with her off court deals.According to Forbes, Coco Gauff is worth a whopping $35 million. While the 22 year old star brought in $7 million from her salary, $28 million came from her partnerships with renowned brands all over the world.Over the last few years, Coco Gauff has collaborated and partnered with many renowned brands, including New Balance, Head, Miu Miu, Mercedes-Benz, Rolex, Ray-Ban Meta, Bose, Oura, Chase Bank, American Express, UPS, Baker Tilly, Barilla, and L'Oréal.In an interview with PEOPLE, Coco Gauff opened up about seeking support from her family as she stays busy with the 2026 US Open.The tennis star said, “I’ve been calling them a lot, bothering them when I’m bored, and they’ve been picking up the phone, so I’m definitely grateful to them always.”

Article Title: Behind Carlos Alcaraz’s success lies a journey of family sacrifices, painful setbacks and difficult moments that tested his dream
Article Text:
Behind Carlos Alcaraz’s success lies a journey of family sacrifices, painful setbacks and difficult moments that tested his dream

Carlos Alcaraz and his family’s financial struggle in his early tennis years

The Guardian

The Guardian

Carlos Alcaraz’s injury struggle and mental battle in 2026

Reuters

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Carlos Alcaraz has reached the top of tennis, but his journey was not always easy. His family had limited money for his early tennis career, meaning they needed outside help to send him to tournaments. Years later, after becoming a Grand Slam champion, Alcaraz faced a different struggle when a wrist injury kept him out for almost five months in 2026. Those moments tested him in very different ways.Alcaraz grew up in a family where tennis was already important. His father, Carlos Alcaraz Sr., had also wanted to become a professional player, but he did not have enough money to take that dream further. He later worked as a tennis coach and administrator.When young Carlos began travelling for tournaments, his own family faced a similar problem. Tennis required money for coaching, travel and other costs, and the family could not pay for everything on its own.His early coach, Kiko Navarro, helped find support from Postres Reina, a local confectionery company in Murcia. According to, the company helped pay for Alcaraz’s trips to tournaments after Navarro asked for financial support.That help mattered because Alcaraz was still only a young player trying to build his career. He had the talent, but he also needed the chance to compete and improve.The support continued as he began travelling around Spain and Europe. His family also had to accept another difficult change when Alcaraz moved away from home to train at Juan Carlos Ferrero’s Equelite Sport Academy in Villena.Navarro toldthat the move was difficult for Alcaraz because he missed his friends and family in Murcia. He still returned home on weekends, but leaving the place where he had grown up was another part of growing into a professional player.Those sacrifices eventually opened the door to the career he has today.By 2026, Alcaraz was no longer a young player looking for an opportunity. He was a seven-time Grand Slam champion and had completed his career Grand Slam by winning the Australian Open.Then came another major test.A wrist injury suffered in April kept Alcaraz away from singles tennis for nearly five months. He missed the French Open, Wimbledon and other important tournaments. For someone used to spending much of the year competing, suddenly having to wait was difficult.The hardest part was not only the injury itself. Alcaraz toldthat the uncertainty around his return led to “intrusive thoughts” and was the most challenging part of his time away from the court.He finally returned to singles at the 2026 US Open, beating Roman Safiullin in straight sets. He then continued his title defence by defeating Wu Yibing and reaching the fourth round.The return showed how different his struggles had become. As a child, Alcaraz needed financial support to keep travelling for tournaments. Years later, he had everything a young player could dream of, yet an injury forced him to step away from the sport.His story is therefore not about having an unusually difficult childhood. It is about facing problems at different stages and continuing to move forward. The family support that helped him begin, along with his ability to deal with setbacks later, played an important part in bringing Alcaraz to where he is today.
Article Summary: Carlos alcaraz has reached the top of tennis, but his journey was not always easy. His family had limited money for his early tennis career, meaning they needed outside help to send him to tournaments. Years later, after becoming a grand slam champion, he faced a different struggle when a wrist injury kept him out for almost five months.

Article Title: 4, 6, 4! Vaibhav Sooryavanshi takes on Mohammed Siraj, lights up Chepauk in Duleep Trophy final - Watch
Article Text:
East Zone's Vaibhav Sooryavanshi plays a shot on day one of the Duleep Trophy 2026-27 final cricket match between South Zone and East Zone, in Chennai. (PTI Photo)

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Teenage batting sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi took on senior India pacer Mohammed Siraj and hit him for three boundaries in a single over on Day 1 of the Duleep Trophy 2026 final between East Zone and South Zone at the MA Chidambaram Stadium in Chennai on Sunday.Opening the innings alongside Abhimanyu Easwaran, Sooryavanshi gave East Zone a fiery start in the first session. The pair continued the good partnership they had built during the knockout matches and helped their team settle quickly.The 15-year-old reached 20-run mark at a brisk pace before attacking Siraj in the seventh over.He began the over with a cut shot past point for four. On the very next ball, he punished a full delivery by clearing his front leg and hitting a straight six over long-off.Siraj then switched to around the wicket, but again bowled a full ball in the slot. Sooryavanshi played the same shot over long-off. This time the ball did not travel over the ropes, but it still raced away for four, giving him three boundaries in the over.Siraj, who had recently played both Tests against Sri Lanka, could not find his usual rhythm in his first spell. He finished his first five overs with figures of 0 for 41.Sooryavanshi's innings ended in the 15th over when he was dismissed for 44. Left-arm pacer Chama Milind got him caught at deep midwicket.After choosing to bat first, East Zone made a strong start in the final. At the time of writing, they were 125/1 after 20 overs, with Abhimanyu Easwaran unbeaten on 70 off 75 balls and Shikhar Mohan batting on 10 off 9 balls.
Article Summary: East zone batsman vaibhav sooryavanshi hit mohammed siraj for three boundaries in a single over. East zone were 125/1 after 20 overs in the duleep trophy 2026 final. Abhimanyu easwaran unbeaten on 70 off 75 balls and shikhar mohan on 10.

Article Title: ‘Shouldn’t have closed door on Mohammed Shami’: Ex-India coach questions Ajit Agarkar-led selectors
Article Text:
Mohammed Shami (PTI Photo)

Bharat Arun unhappy with Shami's treatment

Ishan Kishan also sees hunger in Shami

Shami reaches 100 first-class matches

Former India bowling coach Bharat Arun has questioned the way Mohammed Shami has been treated by the current selection committee led by Ajit Agarkar , insisting that the veteran pacer still has plenty to offer despite being out of the national setup.Shami has not played for India since the Champions Trophy campaign in March 2025, when India went on to win the tournament. Since then, the 36-year-old has remained outside the national team despite putting together a series of strong performances in domestic cricket.His continued absence has fuelled speculation that Shami's international career could be nearing its end. However, Arun believes India should not have shut the door on one of their most experienced fast bowlers.Shami's omission has been particularly noticeable when Jasprit Bumrah has been unavailable, with the Indian management opting to invest in younger pace options rather than recall the experienced Bengal seamer.There was also a public exchange between Shami and Agarkar last year. After the selectors left Shami out of the Test squad for the series against the West Indies, Agarkar raised questions about the pacer's fitness.Shami responded by making it clear that he would not have been playing Ranji Trophy cricket for Bengal had he not been fit.With Shami continuing to perform strongly on the domestic circuit, Arun believes age should not automatically count against him.“They shouldn’t have closed the door on Shami. There is still plenty of cricket left in him. When someone is performing, age shouldn’t be a factor. You see his durability. It is an outstanding number for the kind of talent he possesses. It is actually befitting for Shami. 100 first-class matches with what he loves most, the red ball,” Arun told the Indian Express.Shami is currently representing East Zone in the Duleep Trophy final against South Zone in Chennai, giving him another opportunity to make his case with the red ball.East Zone captain Ishan Kishan has also noticed a different level of intensity from Shami during the current domestic season.Speaking ahead of the Duleep Trophy final, Kishan said the veteran pacer has shown a strong desire to make an India comeback and praised the effort he has been putting into his domestic cricket.“As a captain, looking at the effort, I felt very nice, because Shami bhai coming in, asking me for those extra overs to get the wickets, it always gives confidence,” Ishan said.Kishan added that Shami's attitude has stood out to him, particularly given that he is no longer a regular member of the Indian team.“Looking at Shami bhai this season, I feel he has been very different. I’ve seen him in the past, but his approach towards the game, his intensity, his energy has been very different. When you are not regularly playing for the Indian team and to again have that same kind of motivation for your domestic games, it is tough but I feel I see that hunger in him. I think he has that hunger and that motivation right now like he wants to do that comeback, he wants to be part of Indian squad again and which you can see in him," he added.The Duleep Trophy final has also provided Shami with another significant milestone.The East Zone pacer has featured in his 100th first-class match against South Zone in Chennai, adding another landmark to an accomplished career.Shami also played an important role in East Zone's semi-final victory over defending champions Central Zone, claiming three wickets in the second innings.
Article Summary: Mohammed shami has not played for india since the champions trophy campaign in march 2025. The 36-year-old has remained outside the national team despite putting together a series of strong performances in domestic cricket. Shami is currently representing east zone in the duleep trophy final against south zone in chennai.

Article Title: Trinity Rodman's US Open moment reveals an old habit in sports broadcasting: introducing women by their relationships first
Article Text:
Ben Shelton and Trinity Rodman. Image via: Getty Images

Soccer player Trinity Rodman celebrates after her boyfriend Ben Shelton, of the United States, won his match against Hubert Hurkacz, of Poland, during the second round of the U.S. Open tennis championships Wednesday, Sept. 2, 2026, in New York. (AP Photo/Kirsty Wigglesworth)

Rodman's career does not need Shelton's name attached to it

FILE - Washington Spirit forward Trinity Rodman in action during the second half of an NWSL soccer match against the Portland Thorns FC, Friday, March 13, 2026, in Washington. (AP Photo/Terrance Williams,File)

Call Her Daddy

WAG

Not Gonna Lie with Kylie Kelce

This has happened before

Washington Spirit forward Trinity Rodman shoots as Seattle Reign FC midfielder Samantha Meza, right, looks on during the first half of an NWSL soccer match, Sunday, May 10, 2026, in Seattle. (AP Photo/Lindsey Wasson)

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Trinity Rodman was sitting in Ben Shelton's player box at the US Open on Tuesday when the cameras found her.The ESPN commentary that followed introduced her as “Trinity Rodman, also known as Ben Shelton's girlfriend, and also known as a member of the US women's national team.” The on-screen graphic was similarly arranged: “Ben's girlfriend & USWNT player. ”Rodman is, of course, Shelton's girlfriend. The two tennis and football stars made their relationship public in March 2025, after Rodman slid into Shelton's DMs. Shelton, 23, is one of American tennis's leading players, a left-handed power hitter who reached a career-high world No.5 in late 2025 and has already won four ATP titles in 2026, including the National Bank Open two weeks before the US Open.But Rodman has spent the better part of her career becoming recognisable without him.The 24-year-old is an Olympic gold medallist, an NWSL champion and the highest-paid women's footballer in the world. She is also the daughter of NBA Hall of Famer Dennis Rodman, another fact that has often followed her into introductions of her own.The ESPN description prompted a familiar reaction from fans online, particularly because there was no shortage of things from Rodman's own career that could have been used instead.“Geez… she is so much more than Ben's girlfriend,” one fan wrote.Another put it more bluntly: “Trin is an Olympic gold medalist, NWSL player and then Ben's girlfriend. In that order.”Rodman's football career began long before she became a fixture in Shelton's box.The Washington Spirit selected her No.2 overall in the 2021 NWSL Draft when she was 18, making her the youngest player ever selected at the time. She won the league's Rookie of the Year award and helped Washington win the NWSL Championship in her first season.Three years later, she produced one of the defining moments of her international career.In the 2024 Paris Olympics final, Rodman scored in extra time against Japan as the United States won women's football gold for the first time since 2012. She now has 13 goals in 57 appearances for the USWNT.At club level, her value has grown just as quickly. Rodman became the first player signed under the NWSL's High Impact Player rule and agreed a landmark deal with Washington worth more than $1 million per season through 2028, making her the highest-paid player in the league.There is also the question of her surname, which has brought its own assumptions.Rodman has spoken openly about her complicated relationship with her father and rejected the idea that the name defines her.“He’s not a dad. Maybe by blood, but nothing else,” she said on“I love to have my last name and when I say Rodman, it’s not my dad’s name, it’s my name.”She has been less defensive about being known as Shelton's partner. In fact, Rodman has said she actually likes the term, even while acknowledging why some people dislike it.“For me, I think I like the term personally because, like I said before, I feel like 24/7 I'm on in front of cameras, and so I think I use the term WAG for me to simplify what I'm doing,” she said onin August.“For me, saying WAG, it's me being like, ‘I'm Ben's girlfriend.’ But I can understand why it's so hated.”She described being able to share that experience with Shelton as “the best feeling in the world”, pointing to the fact that both are constantly training, competing and exhausting themselves doing the sports they love.That distinction matters. Rodman choosing to embrace the label is not the same thing as it being the most useful way to introduce her.The US Open moment was not the first time Rodman's identity has been filtered through the people around her.At Wimbledon in 2025, she was introduced during one of Shelton's matches as “Tiffany” and had her father mentioned in the same breath.This time, the mistake was different. Her name was right, her relationship was real and her football career was acknowledged. Yet the order still said something: Ben's girlfriend first, USWNT player second.There was plenty of room for a different introduction.Rodman was not simply another celebrity sitting in a tennis player's box. She was an Olympic champion watching another elite American athlete compete at one of the biggest sporting events in the world.She can be Ben Shelton's girlfriend. She can be Dennis Rodman's daughter. She can even happily call herself a WAG.None of those things requires her own achievements to come second.At 24, Trinity Rodman has already built a career substantial enough to stand on its own. At the US Open, she happened to be there to support someone else.For once, she deserved the spotlight without needing to be introduced through him.
Article Summary: The 24-year-old is an olympic gold medallist, an nwsl champion and the highest-paid women's footballer in the world. She is also the daughter of nba hall of famer dennis rodman, another fact that has often followed her into introductions of her own. Trinity rodman has said she likes being known as ben shelton's wag.

Article Title: “Three-against-one situation”: El Rubius opens up on being “targeted” in MrBeast’s viral $1M challenge
Article Text:
El Rubius reacted honestly after his elimination from MrBeast’s $1 million challenge, calling it “unfair” and claiming he was targeted in a three-against-one situation. Despite his frustration, he thanked fans and gave away his $50,000 winnings. His response felt real and balanced, especially after MrBeast’s team later sent him a cake, softening the moment.

El Rubius reflects on a tough and “unfair” exit

El Rubius did not just walk away from MrBeast’s $1 million streamer challenge. He opened up. Soon after his elimination, the Spanish creator shared a raw reaction with fans, giving them a closer look at what the experience felt like from inside the game. It was not polished or carefully framed. It felt real, and that is exactly why it caught attention so quickly.The clip and his response have since fueled conversations across the streaming space. Some viewers believe intense competitions like this naturally lead to uneven situations. Others feel Rubius may have had a point about being singled out. Either way, his words have added a human layer to a challenge that many only saw as entertainment.Speaking through an Instagram Story, Rubius did not hide his frustration, but he also made sure to thank his supporters. He said, "Guys, I just got knocked out of the game. It was a bit of an unfair elimination, but hey, at least I managed to walk away with $50,000 for you all, which I’ve already distributed. It went to the mods, the subs, and the non-subs alike."He further added, "I’m happy, of course, though admittedly, it was incredibly tough.I wasn't really a fan of the challenge itself, either. But then again... it was basically a three-against-one situation the entire time. I mean, they were targeting me specifically the whole way through. I kept trying to go after RaKai, but, well, he actually just got eliminated in the end. So, at least justice was served for Abraham. Abraham, if you’re watching this, we were all rooting for you, and standing right there with you."His message carried mixed emotions. There was disappointment, yes, but also pride in how he handled things. Giving away his $50,000 winnings to his community stood out as a gesture that meant more than the result itself.He continued with another honest note, saying, "And in the end, karma finally caught up with that little punk. Sorry, I’m being a bit toxic right now, but let's just hope the MrBeast team doesn't see this! Guys, thank you all so much. Seriously, thank you for all the support and for just being there."He added, "Every time I asked for something in the chat or whatever it was, you guys were right there. You’re incredible. I’m a little disappointed in myself, personally, mostly for not performing better, but hey, I gave it my all, and we still walked away with $50,000, so we’ve got to look on the bright side. All right, guys, big hugs to all my brothers out there!"Interestingly, the story did not end with frustration. Later that day, Rubius revealed that MrBeast’s team had sent him a cake after his exit. It was a small gesture, but it shifted the mood. It showed that even in a high-pressure challenge, there is still room for respect.In the end, Rubius’ reaction felt honest and grounded. That is what stayed with people.
Article Summary: El rubius was eliminated from mrbeast's $1 million challenge. He called it "unfair" and said he was targeted in a three-against-one situation. Despite his frustration, he thanked fans and gave away his $50,000 winnings.

But for a 25-year-old techie the craze for IPL tickets for RCB vs CSK turned too costly and he was duped for a massive Rs. 1.46 lakh.The techie, a resident of B Narayanapura, fell into a trap by a post posted by a fraudster who posed himself as a ticket seller on Instagram.As per a report in Deccan Herald, the techie alleged in a complaint to Mahadevapura Police that an individual claiming to be Sumit Biswal promised he could arrange IPL tickets along with food coupons.As per the techie, Biswal was introduced him as a senior supervisor for ticket counter at M Chinnaswamy Stadium"He asked me to come near the stadium gate number 10, saying someone would deliver the tickets within minutes, and even sent an email confirmation to gain my trust," the complainant told Deccan Herald."Initially, I agreed to buy two tickets for Rs 3,700 each,but he kept asking for more money under various pretexts such as refundable security deposits, additional ID cards and food coupons.Trusting him, I made multiple payments - even using my mother’s bank account after exhausting my own limits—and ended up transferring around Rs 1.46 lakh," he added.Bhuvneshwar Kumar’s incisive spell of 3-41, coming after a marauding batting show from Tim David, Rajat Patidar and Devdutt Padikkal, propelled Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) to a commanding 43-run victory over Chennai Super Kings (CSK) in their IPL 2026 encounter at the M Chinnaswamy Stadium on Sunday.The contest saw RCB’s batting unit dismantle CSK’s attack with relentless hitting, as David’s 70 not out off just 25 balls and Patidar’s unbeaten 48 off only 19 balls provided for the late fireworks after Padikkal’s fluent 50 off 29 balls had set the tone for the daunting total.Their combined effort lifted RCB to a daunting 250/3, thus setting a new record for highest total in IPL 2026. Article Title: Meet Kiran Reddy, the 18-year-old Georgia teen who became the first Indian American to win Miss Teen USA
Article Text:
Kiran Reddy makes history just weeks after becoming first Indian American to win Miss Georgia Teen USA

Academic background and roots in Georgia

Cultural impact and upcoming international stage

An 18-year-old student from Douglas, Georgia, has made history by becoming the first Indian American to win the national Miss Teen USA crown. Kiran Reddy defeated 50 other contestants during the 44th annual pageant, held at the Adrienne Arsht Center for the Performing Arts in Miami, Florida, on 26 August 2026, according to WALB News and Pageant Circle. Reddy, who had earlier become the first Indian American to win the Miss Georgia Teen USA title, also secured Georgia’s first national victory in the pageant’s history. Her win marks a double milestone for diversity and state representation in the long-running beauty contest.Speaking after her victory, Reddy shared her emotions about taking on the prestigious title. "I am so blessed to represent Georgia and the U.S. and be the role model I always needed growing up," Reddy said, as reported by KFI AM 640. The national finals brought together contestants from all 50 states and the District of Columbia. Raquel Olea of Arkansas was named first runner-up, while Elisa Akin of New York, Kiersten Alvarado of Indiana, and Chloe Bella Dietz of Texas completed the top five. The event was hosted by model Sean Michael Rae and former titleholder Noelia Voigt.Last year’s winner, Mailyn Marsh of Missouri, placed the crown on her successor. The judging panel included notable figures such as Kelsey Swanson, a former Miss Rhode Island USA.Before gaining national attention, Reddy achieved academic success in Coffee County, Georgia. She graduated as the valedictorian of Coffee High School in Douglas. After graduating from high school, Reddy enrolled at the University of Georgia, where she is studying biological sciences on a pre-medical track. Her goal of working in healthcare has been an important part of her platform alongside her pageant career. Reddy’s journey in pageantry has taken years of hard work. She entered competitive pageants at the age of 15. She finished as first runner-up at the Miss Georgia Teen USA contest in 2024, followed by a second runner-up finish in 2025. Her path to the national title began in June 2026, when she was appointed Miss Georgia Teen USA through an open casting call organised by the national pageant organisation, according to reports by WALB and Wikipedia.Reddy’s historic victory highlights the growing representation of Indian Americans in US beauty pageants. As the first Indian American teenager to win the national crown, her achievement has attracted attention from community leaders and pageant fans around the world. Her duties as Miss Teen USA will soon include international representation. Reddy is scheduled to represent the United States at the Miss Teen Universe contest in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, in October 2026. This will be the first time the national organisation participates in the global event. Along with international travel and official appearances, Reddy plans to continue her undergraduate pre-med studies at the University of Georgia while carrying out her duties as Miss Teen USA. As she steps into the role, Reddy will balance her studies with a year of travel, public appearances and opportunities to advocate for causes close to her heart.
Article Summary: Kiran reddy is the first indian american to win miss georgia teen usa title. The 18-year-old from douglas, georgia, also secured georgia’s first national victory in the pageant's history. Reddy will represent the united states at the miss teen universe contest in phnom penh, cambodia, in october 2026.

Article Title: True Samaritans: Indian volunteers take up grim task of cleaning decomposed bodies in Kathmandu
Article Text:
Volunteers of Hemkunt Foundation cleaning floors of a morgue in Kathmandu. (PC: Hemkunt Foundation)

DEHRADUN:

As rescue agencies continue recovering bodies from flash flood-hit areas in Nepal and bringing them to Kathmandu mortuaries, a group of young Indian volunteers has taken up a task few are willing to do — cleaning decomposed bodies before they are handed over to families and authorities for the last rites. The group has helped clean more than 30 bodies till now.At least seven volunteers -- Harteerath Singh, Neha Singh, Jag Singh, Jaskaran Singh, Ravi Singh, Amitose Singh and Harry Singh -- of Hemkunt Foundation, a Gurgaon-based non-profit organisation, are carrying out the work at the morgue of Maharajgunj Medical Campus, Kathmandu.One of the volunteers, Neha Singh, told TOI Friday that she travelled from Mumbai to Kathmandu for the voluntary service after coming across a social media post by the foundation, requesting volunteers to join them in Nepal. “The next thing I did was to fly down to Kathmandu without expecting anything,” she said, adding that volunteers were not known to each other before reaching there; and were now working as a family in this ‘sewa’ (selfless service).They say that they are totally focused on the task, and even the terrible stench of bodies has failed to deter them. Neha said, “We are here for the respect of the departed souls and the bereaved families.We don’t seek any publicity in that.”Another member of the group, Harteerath Singh, elaborated on some of the challenges being faced by them. “Due to the acute stench, sometimes, it becomes unbearable for us to stand inside the morgue even for a minute,” he pointed out.“But this is the ultimate ‘sewa’. At times, we don’t even bother to wear masks or gloves. We cover our faces with one corner of the turban cloth and just go inside to clean the bodies and floors of the morgue -- something which even the local authorities may not be willing to do,” Singh said.“We also see the positive side of it. It is the biggest opportunity for us to serve humanity.”
Article Summary: At least seven volunteers of hemkunt foundation, a gurgaon-based non-profit organisation, are carrying out the work at the morgue of maharajgunj medical campus, kathmandu. They say that they are totally focused on the task, and even the terrible stench of bodies has failed to deter them.
